venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 11/18 (MOD JK / MKZ; entered by Mya; posted 12:12am ET 11/19)** Net $1,737 vs target $1,649 (105.3%). Food $401; no events; comps $20.30 (1.2%). 45 guests; check avg $38.62. Trivia Wednesday. Opener set the bar up well — great garnish quality, with a reminder to keep garnishes in the correct order. Nice push to start the day with lots of meal deals in the house; most meal-deal guests were first-timers and very happy with their experience. venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 11/18 (MOD MD, Chef JMS; entered by BC; posted 2:13am ET 11/19)** Net $766 vs target $1,000 (76.6%). Food $42; comps $103.90 (13.6%; manager comp for the host of a future event's food, bingo & trivia credit, industry, Neuhoff resident, Neuhoff employee). 36 guests; check avg $21.28. Down-tempo Wednesday — the CMAs were tonight and were probably a factor in the slower night. Pretty sleepy start until trivia, which brought most of the night's guests: three teams of regulars plus one new team (Jolene and Shawn of Ocean Prime). The rest of the night was mostly couples, dates, friends catching up and solo regulars. No late-night pop; bar clear by 11:20pm. Kitchen: John Michael held it down. 86 ponies, Guinness, jalapeño poppers, GF buns; low CVT, tonic, aquavit. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: meeting Shawn and Jolene, who enjoyed trivia and talked about returning next week.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 11/18 (AM MOD Maggie S & Evan; PM MOD Maggie H; entered by MJH; posted 2:10am ET 11/19; form date mis-typed as 2028-11-18)** Net $21,586.74 incl. events vs target $7,890 (273.6%). AM (coffee) $692.03, D&C PM $5,737.21, Garden/6A $9,250. Net event sales $15,157.50 (event food $3,200). Food incl. events $4,663.30 (non-event $1,463.30). Comps $436.70 (2.0%). 312 guests (Tock); check avg $69.19 (net incl. events / guests). AM: short and sweet — early pop until about 9, then mostly calm to a tight close; fresh cold brew and toasted marshmallow on hand. PM: a huge night — 80 investors under one roof plus a 60th birthday party upstairs; event guests were over the moon with the team. Garden/6A: surprise birthday event with 30+ guests, 6–9pm — buffet spread, apps and sliced cake by Lucas W; nice weather, chill vibe, hosts and friends thanked the team on the way out. Kitchen: chill night on the line, a bit steady before close; Chef Lu killed the event. Light prep tomorrow; sold 4 portions of rabbit agnolotti, need crème fraîche. 911 pasta dough, rabbit agnolotti; low lime crumble, cola onions, cherry vermouth jam, chicken thigh in brine, chicken breast, 8oz burger meat, spinach artichoke dip, steak, walnut cilantro pesto. Break make-up complete. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: having David in house and hearing members/investors rave about the team.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 11/18 (MOD Kyler, Chef Michael; entered by Kyler; posted 1:58am ET 11/19)** Net $4,865 vs target $4,706 (103.4%) (form 'Total EOD Net Sales' $4,865; D&C net excl. events listed as $4,866). Food $645, beverage $4,220, retail $0; no events; comps $47.86 (0.9%). 128 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $38.01 (net/guests; form $38). Relatively chill start with only a couple of tables until 6:45pm; the largest party of the night, a nine-top from the Michelin Guide, arrived around 7pm, and the room filled by ~7:30 and stayed rocking until 11pm. Lots of excited guests and first-timers who enjoyed themselves. A small industry pop closed out the night; room emptied just before last call. Kitchen: low shishitos and togarashi aioli. Door: warmer evening (last night without the winter vestibule); slow build to full at 7:45pm, short waitlist of 2–3 groups until a big flip at 9:30, quiet after 10:30; last group sat at midnight. A couple who met here on a blind date a year ago returned married, seated at the same bar seats, followed by a 10-year-anniversary couple in those seats. 2 no-shows (a 2-top at 6pm and an 8-top at 10:30pm); no-shows charged. Menu count 18/18. Breakage: 1 DOF. No incidents; no new maintenance.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 11/18 (MOD Joe, Chefs Josh + Kevin; entered by Joe; posted 4:31am ET 11/19)** Net $11,845 vs target $4,910 (241.2%). Marquee $7,665 (food $1,479); Standing Room $0; event sales $4,180; total food $3,579. Comps $289 (2.4%; industry, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL). 149 guests; check avg $117.93 as reported on the form (net/guests works out to $79.50 — the form figure doesn't reconcile). A very busy Wednesday: started with 70+ covers on the books, 30 of them for a Standing Room event from 7–10pm. The event itself was slow — only 17 of the 30 guests showed, but they made the best of it and left happy. The Marquee bar was busy start to finish: room filled around 8pm and stayed almost completely full until last call, with a sizeable waitlist at one point that the team turned through quickly. A nice preview of the busy season ahead. Enoch and Mia crushed the floor; Angel ran service bar all night and kept ticket times down. Kitchen: busy night between Marquee and Standing Room. Maintenance: water taps acting up again. 86 oysters, tuna, trout roe. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 11/18 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 1:30am ET 11/19)** Net $3,305.12 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $4,240 (78.0%). Marquee bar / total sales $3,635.64; Garden $0; food $442; no event sales reported. Discounts $98 (3.0%; DNL $78, gift $20). 77 guests (48 walk-ins, 28 reservations); check avg $42.92 (net/guests; form $39.35). A slower night, with the biggest pop around 7pm. Jayla was in for host-opening training with Chaz — strong on SevenRooms and learning steps of service — and shadowed Devan on the floor before heading out by 8; Sasha came in at 7 for bar training and did very well. With things light, Chaz knocked out ABK tasks while Marcus took the host stand; Devan ran the room solo; Jada and Alex passed tickets. Last call came naturally at 11:30pm. A couple of disgruntled guests at the bar top — incident report filed. Kitchen: lighter night; James stayed on top of dish and kept ticket times low; kitchen close checked. Went well: communication, pacing, training. To improve: keep resetting to zero even when it's slow. Maintenance: curtain. No-shows not charged; $0 no-show revenue.

venues.weather: Cloudy, light sprinkles, 50s into mid 40s; did not affect service
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 11/18 (MOD Alexis Mendoza; entered by Alexis Mendoza; posted 3:23am ET 11/19)** Net $6,857 vs target $7,917 (86.6%). Food $909; no events; comps $309.12 (4.5%; Surprise & Delights, employee and neighbor discounts, 4 DNLs; lots of members in, plus a team member's parents). 147 guests; check avg $46.64. Curtis off. Calm start with a good number of walk-ins; reservations picked up around 4:30pm, then a good pace and consistent flow all night with tables full most of the evening. One large party for a member's birthday. Floor ran smooth, bar had a nice groove, all breaks taken, early cuts on both bar and floor; guests stayed for a good last round. Kitchen: handled it with ease; staff meal was tasty. Maintenance: pot & pan detergent cord broke in the kitchen — need to call Auto-Chlor. Low on pilsner and sour beers. No incidents; no-shows not charged.
